L200: ### A
L201: 
L202: cite83†Assessor L203: The Board of Assessors is charged with accurately determining the value of all real and personal property located within the City of Everett for the purpose of taxation.
L204: ### C
L205: 
L206: cite84†City Clerk L207: The City Clerk is also the Chief Election Official, Clerk of the Board of Aldermen, and City Archivist.
L208: 
L209: cite85†City Solicitor L210: The City Solicitor’s Office is responsible for providing representations and advice to the City, the mayor and its officials in numerous areas.
L211:

L214: cite42†Council on Aging L215: Discover information related to the Council on Aging, as well as events and activities sponsored by the council.
L216: ### D
L217: 
L218: cite87†Diversity, Equity, Inclusion L219: To cultivate, advance and foster a culture of belonging in the City of Everett where all people who live, work, and visit have equitable access to the resources and opportunities the City offers.
L220: ### E
L221: 
L222: cite88†E911 L223: The mission of the 911 Communication Center is to provide the citizens of Everett with a reliable, state of the art 911 Emergency Telephone System.
L224: 
L225: cite89†ECTV/Communications L226: Everett Community Television (ECTV) is a municipal station established to manage and operate the Public (Channel 3), Educational (Channel 15), and Government (Channel 22) access channels of the Everett, Massachusetts cable television system.
L227: cite90†Elections Office L228: The Registrars of Voters are responsible for procedures relating to the registration of voters, develop and maintain annual list of voters, and conduct the annual census of residents of the City.
L229: ### F
L230: 
L231: cite92†Finance L232: Learn more about the Collector and Purchasing divisions.
L233: 
L234: cite141†Fire†everettfirema.com L235: The Everett Fire Department is a professional fire department employing 103 career firefighters who are dedicated to serving the citizens of Everett with the highest degree of care and professionalism.
L236: ### H
L237: 
L238: cite94†Health Department L239: Through regulatory enforcement, policy development, and coalition building the Everett Health Department’s mission is to prevent disease and injury, promote wellness, and protect the personal, community, and environmental health of all Everett residents.
L240: cite33†Human Resources L241: The Human Resources Department is responsible for ensuring that employees are hired, compensated and managed properly and fairly, for providing assistance to other departments and the oversight of all personnel related functions.
L242: 
L243: cite95†Human Services L244: The Office of Human Services helps Everett residents with many types of assistance. The main purpose of the office is information and referral.
L245: ### I
L246: 
L247: cite97†Information Technology L248: The mission of the Department is to provide and enhance technology platforms that support the City’s main functions and increases governmental efficiency for the Everett residents.
L249: 
L250: cite142†Inspectional Services L251: Our primary mission is to safeguard the public, promote the health, safety and welfare for the residents of the City of Everett.

L271: cite101†Public Works L272: The Department of Public Works (DPW) is responsible for a variety of City services.
